entities.name: Anjum Saeed

entities.summary: Anjum Saeed is a Pakistani former field hockey player. He was a member of Pakistan's Asian champion team that won the gold medal at the 1990 Asian Games, beating India 3–2 in the final, and a bronze medal at the 1992 Summer Olympics in Barcelona.
